description: Cardinal, elevation, seam and pole checks for the source-to-Unreal world frame. Hand-authored from the coordinate contract, not captured from an Unreal session. A tangent origin (latitude, longitude, origin height) turns a globe point in metres into Unreal centimetres: X follows east, Y follows north, Z follows radial up, lengths scale by 100 once and unit axes only permute. Numeric agreement between the native core and the Python oracle: relative 1e-12, absolute 1e-9.

sign_cases.name: a point east of the origin has Unreal X greater than zero
a point north of the origin has Unreal Y greater than zero
greater radial height has Unreal Z greater, never Y
west and south and below invert every axis

axis_cases.name: a width axis that is source east aligns with Unreal +X
a source up axis is Unreal +Z and is not scaled
a source north axis is Unreal +Y

identity_cases.name: the seam at longitude 180 resolves to the same direction as -180
the north pole up axis is the globe +Y axis for every longitude
the south pole up axis is the globe -Y axis for every longitude

winding: reverse source triangle indices when copying them into a left-handed Unreal index buffer
